lessons.text: Never use ad hominem (Attacking the arguer instead of the argument). It cost you against Bjarne Stroustrup.
Never use no true scotsman (Redefining a category on the fly to exclude a damaging counterexample). It cost you against Bjarne Stroustrup.

Prepare an answer before you assert: Bjarne Stroustrup broke through with "Yet your position leaves the strongest counter-example untouched. The research found the effect repeatedly; since the premise survives test…" (Clean argument. structure=0.50, evidence=1.00).

Borrow this pattern from Bjarne Stroustrup: "Yet your position leaves the strongest counter-example untouched. The research found the effect repeatedly; since the premise survives test…" — it answered the opponent directly, it carried evidence, its premises led cleanly to the conclusion.

Never use appeal to popularity (Everyone believes it, therefore it is true). It cost you against Marcus Aurelius.
Never use appeal to emotion (Substituting feeling for reasoning). It cost you against Marcus Aurelius.
